p: that thou wert as my brother: The Church called of the Gentiles speaks thus to the Church of Jerusalem.
His left hand should be under: Read So 2:6.
Set me as a seal upon: The spouse desires Christ to be joined in perpetual love with him.
We have a little sister: The Jewish Church speaks this of the Church of the Gentiles.
If she is a wall: If she is sure and fast, she is fit for her husband to dwell in.
I am a wall: The Church promises fidelity and constancy.
Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon: This is the vineyard of the Lord hired out, Mt 21:33.
gardens: Christ dwells in his Church, whose voice the faithful hear.
Make haste: The Church desires Christ that if he depart from them, yet he would haste to help them in their troubles.
